_comment: ADCNN v2_D RELEASE CANDIDATE (rc1). Frozen detector for the same-night faint-fast 2-visit ALERT product. Blind-confirmed STRONG WIN over v1: faint-fast 2v alert completeness 3.64%->10.33% (+184%, 2.8x) at held purity (86.1->88.6%) on the 26 frozen DM-53195 blind fields. See ADCNN_V2_RESULT.md. v1 remains the prior baseline (tag adcnn-v1-blind-baseline).
supersedes: v1 (adcnn-v1-blind-baseline) for the faint-fast alert product

mf_len_debias._comment: Model-specific trail-length de-bias re-derived for v2_D's tighter ends-bloom (v1 was 33.4/0.887). Apply via env ADCNN_MF_LEN_OFFSET / ADCNN_MF_LEN_SLOPE at detection, OR post-hoc recompute_lendb.py. len_db = clip((raw_mf_length - offset)/slope, 0).
mf_len_debias.fit: field-held-out on non-blind DM-53195 dev injections, residual ~1px over 6-60px

detection._comment_thr: Detect at the 0.50 retention floor; the alert op S>=0.80 is applied in the linker pair stage. The FP-budget calibrated threshold in cnn_postproc.train.json is NULL (calibration step OOM/pool-crashed, NOT needed for this op).

frozen_alert_op: ADCNN/pipelines/heliolinc/op_2v_alert.json (UNCHANGED from v1: S>=0.80, mfsnr>=5, chi2<=5, len_db>=6, rate[1,8], top-50/night)

ecliptic._note: ecliptic purity conservative (real asteroids labeled fp)

blind_result.harness_check: v1 reproduced its original blind numbers exactly -> harness validated

exposure_leakage._comment: Training was tract-disjoint from blind but NOT exposure-disjoint: adjacent tracts on shared night 20250723 share boundary-CCD (visit,detector) exposures. Full audit (ADCNN/pipelines/heliolinc/leakage_audit/leakage_audit.json) vs the 26 blind manifests: ALL leaked exposures fall in ONLY blind fields 0 and 1; the other 24 fields are provably disjoint. Therefore ALL-26 is NOT strictly blind; CLEAN-24 (drop fields 0,1) is a leakage-FREE blind evaluation and is the DEFENSIBLE headline.

per_stage_leaked_visit_detector.note: 8+4=the 12 direct training exposures; 99 = the broader MF_LEN/threshold dev pool (run_dev). All in fields 0,1.

exposure_leakage.integrity_headline: DEFENSIBLE blind number = CLEAN-24 +192% (3.68->10.74%); leakage-free by construction (0 leaked exposures in the 24 fields) and >= the all-26 +184%.
exposure_leakage.recommendation: For a FULLY-CLEAN all-26 tag, rebuild run_ft/run_ft_cnn/run_dev excluding blind (visit,detector) pairs (the data stage now enforces this via leakage_guard) + re-confirm. Until then cite CLEAN-24, not ALL-26, as the blind result.

scope_caveats: Trained/dev-gated on OFF-ECLIPTIC DM-53195; ecliptic blind gain is out-of-domain transfer (encouraging, conservative purity).
Alert load ~2.6x v1 (ranked + top-50 capped; mfsnr_min knob if follow-up saturates).
Real-sky base-rate-corrected purity remains low -> alert stream, not standalone discovery (unchanged from v1).
